intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently choose a complex randomized photographic test concept using the supplied portrait; one-piece fashion swimwear is the delegated test category, and its exact garment, setting and event are agent-created, not requester-specified details.

Photograph an adult woman in her late twenties, using the attached portrait as her facial and dark wavy hair appearance reference, in a flooded glass conservatory beside a lap pool. She wears a deep petrol one-piece swimsuit with one broad left shoulder strap, a bare right shoulder, a diagonal front wrap panel, a small right side-waist keyhole, and a wide continuous hip band connecting the covered front to the side. Opaque lined stretch fabric and narrow bound edges clearly establish a functional fashion swimsuit; the diagonal panel is a real overlapping fabric edge with fine stitching. Frame her from head to upper shins in a front three-quarter view, with the swimsuit front and right waist readable. She is catching a wind-lifted striped towel with her right hand held away from her waist; the towel billows beyond her right side while her left hand hangs beside her left thigh. A gust through an open glass door bows nearby fern fronds and pulls several damp hair strands sideways. Her bare feet stand in a shallow film of water on pale stone, with spreading ripples around one lifted heel. Warm low sunlight crosses the conservatory mullions and grazes the wrap seam, while cool reflected pool light fills the shadow side. Wet glass, fern silhouettes, suspended towel folds and a distant lane stripe create layered depth. Keep the shoulder asymmetry, sewn wrap edge and side keyhole visually distinct from their cast shadows. Render lifelike skin texture, small water beads on fabric and physically coherent reflections as a precise editorial photograph.
